---
title: "Ranked GSEA"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(clusterProfiler)
library(msigdbr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
#load data from python
ranked <- read.csv("paired_ranked_gene_list_for_gsea.csv")
```

```{r}
# clusterProfiler wants a NAMED, SORTED numeric vector: names = gene symbols,
# values = ranking statistic (DESeq2's Wald stat)
gene_list <- ranked$stat
names(gene_list) <- ranked$gene_symbol
gene_list <- sort(gene_list, decreasing = TRUE) #must be sorted descending

head(gene_list)
tail(gene_list)
```

```{r}
hallmark_sets <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens",category = "H") %>% dplyr::select(gs_name, gene_symbol)
```

```{r}
#run GSEA
gsea_res <- GSEA(
  geneList = gene_list,
  TERM2GENE = hallmark_sets,
  pvalueCutoff = 1,
  minGSSize = 10,
  maxGSSize = 500,
  seed = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
gsea_df <- as.data.frame(gsea_res) %>% arrange(p.adjust)
```

```{r}
colnames(gsea_df)
```

```{r}
up   <- subset(gsea_df, p.adjust < 0.05 & NES > 0)
down <- subset(gsea_df, p.adjust < 0.05 & NES < 0)
```

```{r}
print(up[order(-up$NES), c("Description", "NES", "p.adjust", "core_enrichment")])
```

```{r}
print(down[order(down$NES), c("Description", "NES", "p.adjust", "core_enrichment")])
```
